title: A Pre-Specified Construction-Confirmation Test of Operation-Level Causal Transfer Across Finite Isomorphic Symbolic Domains
abstract: arXiv:2608.15809v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Behavioral accuracy, linear decodability, and successful activation interventions do not by themselves show that a model carries an operation-level structure from one symbolic domain to another. We ask a narrower question in finite isomorphic state spaces: if the hidden-state difference between two operations is estimated separately for each source input, does adding that difference to a mapped recipient input move the model toward the corresponding recipient answer? The design compares this input-specific intervention with wrong-operation, norm-matched random, and no-op controls, and separates candidate construction from an independently isolated confirmation split. translated_title: 有限同构符号域上操作级因果迁移的预指定构建-确认检验
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15809v1 公告类型：新 摘要：行为准确性、线性可解码性和成功的激活干预本身并不能证明模型从一个符号域到另一个符号域携带了操作级结构。我们在有限同构状态空间中提出了一个更窄的问题：如果两个操作之间的隐藏状态差异是分别针对每个源输入估计的，那么将该差异添加到映射后的接收输入是否会推动模型朝向相应的接收答案？该设计将此输入特定干预与错误操作、规范匹配随机和无操作控制进行比较，并将候选构建与独立隔离的确认分割分开。在冻结的Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct模型第20-21层上，一个来自在确认访问前预指定并冻结的家族的路线-域-操作候选，透明|整数模16-字母16|后继->前驱，通过了两个PyVene分割；其确认间隔...
tldr: 本文提出一种预指定构建-确认检验方法，验证冻结语言模型在有限同构符号域间是否真正存在操作级因果迁移，并通过透明候选在Qwen2.5-7B模型中成功验证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a pre-specified construction-confirmation test to verify whether operation-level causal transfer truly exists across finite isomorphic symbolic domains, successfully validating a transparent candidate in a frozen Qwen2.5-7B model.
